Power Integrations, onsemi, Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Infineon OTC ADR, Delta, Lite-On, Flex, and ABB appear in the 800VDC ecosystem but were not included due to the four-candidate cap; later passes should map them by exchange listing, purity, and market-cap fit.

The central chokepoint is not only facility power availability; it is the staged conversion path from AC/grid or HVDC distribution to 800VDC, intermediate bus, 48V or lower rails, and ultimately sub-1V processor core delivery.

node: AI rack power conversion from grid input to point-of-load
summary: Layer 1B expansion for AI rack power conversion finds a small set of US-listed power-conversion names with plausible exposure to the shift from legacy 48/54V rack distribution toward higher-voltage 800VDC architectures and denser point-of-load delivery. Reference context remains NVIDIA's 800VDC ecosystem and larger analog/power suppliers, but this pass prioritizes less-obvious component/module vendors: Vicor for high-density modular power and vertical/point-of-load delivery, Navitas for GaN/SiC optionality in 800VDC AI factories, Bel Fuse for AC/DC and DC/DC rack power supplies, and Monolithic Power Systems as a higher-attention reference for cloud/HPC point-of-load power modules. None of these are buy/sell recommendations; weaker claims require revenue, design-win, customer, and volume-ramp verification.
